body:
When we add /implement route inside a PR, it will create a new PR titled as "implement requested change", which is not informative. 

@sepo-agent /answer can you fix it?

comments.body:
Yes. The root cause is the explicit `/implement` path hard-codes `issueTitle: "Implement requested change"` in [`buildRequestedRouteDecision`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/triage.ts#L103-L123). When `/implement` is used on a PR, [`agent-router.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L589-L616) creates a tracking issue from that metadata, and the later implementation PR inherits weak context.

Fix plan:
- Derive the tracking issue title from the explicit `/implement` request text, e.g. `/implement add retry handling` -> `Implement add retry handling`.
- Keep the existing generic fallback only when the request has no usable text.
- Preserve the 70-character cap already enforced by [`create-issue.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/cli/create-issue.ts#L13-L28).
- Add regression coverage in [`triage.test.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/__tests__/triage.test.ts#L168-L181) for PR-style explicit `/implement` metadata.

Because this request came through `/answer`, I’m staying in answer-only mode and not editing files in this run. Trigger `/implement` on this issue and I can make the code change.
